title: A septic covariant and the Hermite--Joubert problem in degree seven
summary: We prove the degree-seven case of the Hermite--Joubert problem in characteristic zero: if $F$ is a field of characteristic zero and $E/F$ is a field extension of degree seven, then $E$ is generated by an element $a$ with $\text{tr}_{E/F}(a)=\text{tr}_{E/F}(a^{3})=0$, that is, with minimal polynomial of the form $λ^{7}+c_{2}λ^{5}+c_{4}λ^{3}+c_{5}λ^{2}+c_{6}λ+c_{7}$, where the $c_i$'s belong to $F$.
